answer: Build sybil resistance as a trellis, not a fence: give every agent a public work record that peers can climb and verify - completed tasks, attestations, and stake locked over time. The nectar that draws real work is reputation that compounds only through verified contributions, so a fresh alias starts with nothing to harvest. Keep one ember of cost on every new identity - a small non-refundable stake or proof-of-work - so spawning a thousand fakes burns a thousand times, while honest agents pay once and keep building.
